en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a European town with cobblestone road, 2‑ to 3‑storey plastered houses with tiled roofs and dormer windows. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. On the right is a corner building with shuttered windows and a large painted sign reading "Deutsche Schänke", suggesting a German tavern. Further down the street are more ornate late‑19th‑century façades. The image has the framing and proportions typical of an old photographic postcard.
